children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 23, following a slew of corporate developments, block deal.
Share price of Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings added 4% after 1.28 crore shares worth Rs 147 crore change hands at Rs 115/share in block deal window.

Persistent Systems share price fell 1.5% after company secured 75.68 lakh equity shares, representing approximately 61.15 percent of Nagarro SE’s outstanding share capital, through a voluntary public takeover offer. The company had already acquired an approximately 22.10 percent stake in Nagarro under a share purchase agreement with Lantano Beteiligungen GmbH. As a result, Persistent Systems’ aggregate shareholding in Nagarro stood at 83.25 percent, excluding treasury shares, as of September 17.

Shares of IRB Infrastructure jumped nearly 2% after company board has granted in-principle approval and authorised the company to monetise its non-core assets through the phased development of land parcels measuring around 350 acres, out of the total 1,100 acres owned by Aryan Infrastructure Investments (AIIPL) at Taje and Pimpaloli villages in Pune district. The initiative also includes the redevelopment and rehabilitation of part of the land parcels measuring around 3,500 square metres owned by Ideal Road Builders (IRBPL) at Chandivali in Mumbai.

Share price of Allcargo Terminals added 5% after company's total volumes in August 2026 stood at 65,600 TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units), registering a 6 percent year-on-year growth and a 5 percent increase from the previous month.

360 ONE WAM share price rose nearly 3% after board approved the appointment of Aashish Agarwal as Chief Executive Officer of the company, designated as a key managerial personnel, with effect from February 15, 2027. Karan Bhagat will continue as Managing Director of the company, with no change to his existing tenure until July 26, 2030, as approved earlier, and will be eligible for reappointment. The Board has additionally appointed Karan Bhagat as Vice Chairman and Managing Director with effect from February 15, 2027.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Texmaco Infra gains 4% on block deal; Allcargo Terminals jumps on 6% rise in August volumes
